title: My Fiancé's Son-in-Law Called Me a Gold Digger and Hired a Detective. He Found a 1975 Photo.
description:
The night Hal put a ring on my finger, his son-in-law stood up at the dinner table and called me a gold digger in front of the whole family. Then he hired a private detective to dig up my past.

He found a photograph from 1975. He had no idea who was in it. Stay until the wedding, when he stood up to object.
